pg_0000.label: Assess the fused contact picture (bearing/range/CPA/TCPA) against own-ship's course and speed.

pg_0002.label: Execute the action: alter_course (+30 degrees to starboard, lookahead distance 200 m).

pg_0006.label: Execute the action: resume_cruising_speed (return to cruising speed).

condition: Minimum CPA stays above the safe-distance threshold.
Minimum CPA to BOTH targets stays above the safe-distance threshold.

guidance: Rule 14, Rule 15, Rule 16 governs this encounter.
pitfalls: Own-ship alters course to starboard (not port).
Own-ship avoids crossing ahead of the target.
Own-ship does not alter to port toward the target if she must eventually act.
